module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM loads operands on start, iterates conditional add/shift over multiplier bits, then pulses done.

anchors.name: m
anchors.why: Idle/run/finish controller; loads operands, sequences iterations, drives busy and done.

anchors.name: acc
anchors.why: Partial-product accumulator updated each iteration; drives product output p.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Multiplicand shift register, shifted left each iteration and added into acc.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Multiplier shift register; LSB selects whether to add multiplicand.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Iteration counter; reaching 16 ends the run state.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Iteration-complete flag moving FSM from run to finish.

anchors.name: t
anchors.why: Conditional add result acc+x selected by multiplier LSB.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start request in idle; loads operands and begins multiply.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: Product output taken directly from acc.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse registered in finish state.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy status while FSM in run state.

groups.name: mul_ctrl
groups.description: Start/run/finish sequencing with busy and done outputs.

groups.name: iter_counter
groups.description: Counts shift-add iterations and flags completion.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Shifted multiplicand conditionally added into accumulator per multiplier bit.
